7.content: ... ... that they were opened to receive the waste.

spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Ten Works of the Divine Emissary

**¶1:** The mediating influx of divine truth accomplished a complete series of spiritual operations by its descent into the states of the mind.

**¶2:** The first: The divine ordering principle came forth to establish a new state of regenerate life — an interior heaven arranged according to celestial order.

**¶3:** The second: The doctrinal vessels bearing wisdom moved through the most interior and elevated states of consciousness.

**¶4:** The third: The providential cycles of spiritual progression began to transmit the good of life into the natural mind and into the higher degrees of understanding alike.

**¶5:** The fourth: [GAP-1] — *The spiritual sequence here requires some further operation preparatory to the opening of doctrinal forms; likely the readying or arranging of containing vessels so that influx could be both given and received.*

**¶6:** The fifth is the openings of the doctrinal vessels, that they were unsealed [GAP-2] — *so that the wisdom and truth contained within could flow outward into receiving states.*

**¶7:** The sixth is the openings also [GAP-3] of the lower containing forms, that they were opened to receive what is rejected — the refuse of purification, the falsities and evils separated out during the ordering of the interior life.

**¶8:** The seventh is [GAP-4: the self-derived evil], which the divine influx had distinguished and separated from the ruling affections of self-love by means of the mediating operation of truth; it descended into the natural mind, where it could be made manifest and confronted.

**¶9:** The eighth: States of spiritual obscurity and states of spiritual illumination were clearly distinguished from one another [GAP-5] — *so that the mind could discern what belongs to falsity and what belongs to truth.*

**¶10:** The ninth: The malformed conceptions of the will — affections and intentions conceived from evil that could bear no genuine spiritual life — [GAP-6: were cast down] into the lowest natural degree, where they lay without vitality.

**¶11:** The tenth: The successive passage of spiritual states through changing forms commenced within the boundary region of the natural mind — whereby affections cycle through external vessels, undergoing transformation toward either reformation or further confirmation in evil.

---

**Translator's note on the whole:** This chapter describes, in complete sequence, how divine truth operating as a mediating influx reorganizes the entire mind: first establishing new interior order (¶2), then activating the doctrinal forms that carry wisdom through the higher degrees (¶3–4), then opening those forms both to pour out good and to receive what must be purged (¶6–7), then separating evil from its ruling disguises and casting it into the natural where it becomes visible (¶8), then distinguishing light-states from dark-states (¶9), then expelling what was conceived in evil but never truly alive (¶10), and finally setting into motion the great cycling of affections through natural forms that constitutes the ongoing work of regeneration (¶11). The ten operations form a complete descent from the inmost to the outmost.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The Ambassador performed ten works by his advent.
The first: The Great Builder came forth to build the new aeon.
The second: The ships moved through the heights in the heavens.
The third: The wheels begin to send the life to earth and the upper worlds.
The fourth: [The Column of Glory was raised up]
The fifth is the doors of the ships, that they were opened up [to pour forth the light]
The sixth is the doors too [of the earths below, that they were opened to receive the waste]
The seventh is [the Sin], which he had separated from the rulers by cause of the Third Ambassador; it fell upon the earth.
The eighth: Night and day were separated [from one another by the revolution of the sphere]
The ninth: The abortions [fell] to the ground.
The tenth: Transmigrations came about in the zone.

fills.fill: The Column of Glory was raised up
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading calls for "the readying or arranging of containing vessels so that influx could be both given and received," which in Manichaean natural-plane vocabulary is the Column of Glory — the cosmic pathway/vessel through which purified light ascends from the world through the ships to the New Aeon, positioned between the activation of the wheels (third) and the opening of the doors (fifth).

The spiritual reading states the doors were unsealed "so that the wisdom and truth contained within could flow outward into receiving states," which in Manichaean cosmological vocabulary is the pouring forth of purified light from the ships, directly paralleling the sixth work where doors open "to receive the waste."

fills.fill: of the earths below, that they were opened to receive the waste
fills.original: ... ... that they were opened to receive the waste.
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading specifies "the lower containing forms" that open to receive "what is rejected — the refuse of purification," which in the Kephalaia's cosmological register are the doors of the earths below, forming a structural parallel with the fifth work (doors of the ships opened upward to release light) and completing the paired outflow/reception sequence.

The spiritual reading identifies this as "the self-derived evil" separated from the ruling affections; in the Manichaean Kephalaia, "the Sin" (ⲡⲛⲟⲃⲉ) is the standard term for the concupiscent evil matter that fell from the archons when the Third Ambassador appeared — the editor's choice is confirmed.

fills.fill: from one another by the revolution of the sphere
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading calls for the establishment of discernment between states of illumination and obscurity; in Manichaean cosmology, night and day are separated by the turning of the cosmic sphere/firmament, which is the natural-plane mechanism that distinguishes light-states from dark-states.

The spiritual reading says the malformed conceptions "were cast down" into the lowest natural degree; in the Kephalaia's register, the abortions (monstrous offspring of the archons) "fell" to the ground — the editor's choice is confirmed as the standard Manichaean formulation for this event.
